nodes.name: router.py
nodes.summary: Implements the authentication HTTP surface, including signup, login, token refresh, logout, email verification, password recovery, MFA, and secure cookie management.
nodes.languageNotes: FastAPI dependency injection supplies authenticated users and database sessions at endpoint boundaries.

nodes.name: _cookie_kwargs
nodes.summary: Returns the shared secure cookie attributes used for authentication cookies.

nodes.name: _delete_cookie
nodes.summary: Deletes an authentication cookie using the same scope and security attributes used when setting it.

nodes.name: _clear_cookie_variants
nodes.summary: Clears all supported variants of an authentication cookie.

nodes.name: _set_refresh_cookie
nodes.summary: Writes the refresh token to a protected browser cookie.

nodes.name: _set_access_cookie
nodes.summary: Writes the access token to a protected browser cookie.

nodes.name: _set_csrf_cookie
nodes.summary: Writes the browser-readable CSRF token used to protect cookie-authenticated requests.

nodes.name: _clear_auth_cookies
nodes.summary: Removes access, refresh, and CSRF cookies after logout or failed refresh.

nodes.name: _build_user
nodes.summary: Serializes a persisted account into the authenticated-user response model.
